question: In December 2024, which government project won the SKOCH Award for excellence in forest management?

options.text: Social Forestry Schemes of Madhya Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is option 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Nagaland Forest Management Project** focuses on sustainable forest management practices, biodiversity conservation, and enhancing the livelihood of communities dependent on forests.
 
• The project is funded by the **Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)**, emphasizing international collaboration in environmental conservation.
 
• It aims to restore degraded forests, improve forest productivity, and ensure equitable benefits for local communities.
 
• Key components include afforestation, promotion of agroforestry, and capacity building to support sustainable forest management.
 
• The project has demonstrated significant progress in forest management, earning it the prestigious **SKOCH Award for excellence** in December 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Forest Management:** Forest management refers to practices aimed at maintaining and improving the health and sustainability of forest ecosystems.
 
• **Biodiversity Conservation:** Efforts to preserve the variety of life forms within ecosystems, including flora, fauna, and microorganisms.
 
• **Agroforestry:** A land management system that integrates trees and shrubs into agricultural landscapes for environmental and economic benefits.
 
• **SKOCH Award:** The SKOCH Award is a prestigious recognition given to projects and initiatives demonstrating excellence in governance, technology, and social impact.
 
• **Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA):** JICA is a governmental agency that provides financial and technical assistance to support development projects worldwide, including environmental conservation initiatives.
